svg.title: Filtering the speed that D uses
svg.desc: Without a filter the holding torque flickers between 1.31 and 2.68 newton-metres; a 0.1 second filter keeps it between 1.89 and 2.05 and moves the shaft as before, while a 0.5 second filter delays the braking so much that the step overshoots 0.27 radians.
svg.text: Filtering the speed that D uses
Control Studio validation runs on the actual ST · same angle noise in every run · numbers answer the predictions
No filter: 1.31–2.68 N·m while standing still
Tf 0.5 s: D brakes too late, overshoot 0.27 rad
Tf 0.1 s moves like no filter: overshoot 0.007 rad
